description: Ministry of Labour - Industrial Disputes between A. Thiyagarajah Bandarawela and other part Sri Lanka Transport Board, Colombo 05 - Industrial Disputes between S. A. Kamalasena Buttala and other part Lanka Sugar Company (Pvt.) Ltd. Colombo 04
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with legal/regulatory matters under the Industrial Disputes Act, specifically the revocation and issuance of orders for arbitration in an industrial dispute. It involves statutory instruments (orders under Section 4(1) of the Act) and legal procedures for dispute resolution, without focusing on government personnel changes, organizational structure, or any of the other specialized categories. The mention of the Minister is incidental to the legal authority exercising statutory powers, not the main focus of the gazette.
